summary: The same man won the same kind of seat two years later and kept it for years.
realLife: Lincoln won on August 4, 1834, representing Sangamon County, and was re-elected in 1836, 1838 and 1840.
sources: National Park Service, Lincoln Chronology, Lincoln Home National Historic Site: https://www.nps.gov/liho/learn/historyculture/lincolnchronology.htm
